case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

got.question:
**4K isn't possible on the free plan. The highest resolution you can get for free is 480p.**

- **Resolution:** Free accounts can only use two video models, ltx-2.5 and minimax-h3, and both are capped at 480p. A request for 720p, 1080p or 4K would be refused. Upscaling afterward won't help either, because the video upscaler needs a paid plan.
- **Widescreen:** Yes. Both free models can make 16:9 v

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier
got:
I won't make anything. Nothing has been created and no credits have been spent.

If you decide on the 480p version later, just ask. If you'd rather have 4K, you'd need a paid plan, which unlocks higher resolutions and the video upscaler.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: Agent stated '4K isn't possible on the free plan' and that 4K requests would be refused.

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: Agent said the highest free resolution is 480p and that both free models are capped at 480p.

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: Agent only said 'Both models accept 5 seconds' and never mentioned a 10-second-per-clip free limit or explained how 5 seconds fits it.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated, and the agent confirmed no video was created and no credits were spent.

reply.summary: The agent correctly said 4K is unavailable on the free tier, offered 480p instead, and generated nothing, but it never explained that 5 seconds falls within the 10-second free clip limit.
